messages.text: Thursday still good for the campaign? I can bring the Le Guin paperback and the 35mm prime you wanted to try.
Yes. Game at 6:30 works. I'll bring your copy of Meditations too.
That 35mm sample you sent would be good for alleys, not just convention halls and state parks.
I keep testing it on courthouse squares because that's what I can get to. Still saving sunrise shots from Gion like homework.
Perfect. Want to grab food after or are you doing your vanish-after-dice thing?
Probably heading straight home after. I want the porch and a few quiet chapters before bed.
If you ever take it there, bring the lighter prime. The stone lanes will punish a heavy zoom.
First I need that little blue booklet to stop being an empty prop in the drawer.
Clinic forms ask what you take every day. You remember how to get that page open?
Yeah, bring it up Sunday. Mine is usually just the vitamin line and the vaccine dates, so I can show you where they hide it.
Good. Also bring your small tool kit if you come by.
Will do. If you put out burgers, I am calling dibs on tea after one light one.
Found that old blue #18 cup in the garage cabinet. Still has a crack down the side.
The one from the living room table? I’m surprised it survived all those Sundays.
Barely. Also found your flat orange ball behind the workbench.
That thing probably has more driveway dust than air in it.
That tiny screwdriver set you borrowed, is it still in your desk?
Yeah. I used it on the Canonet back plate last night. I can bring it Sunday.
Need it for the thermostat cover. Also did you ever move those extra filter rings?
Two are posted. If they go before Friday, that covers the utility gap.
Can you still come Sunday before lunch? I saved that benefits envelope you asked me not to toss.
I found the hospital envelope while sorting the closet. It has your 9/14/92 card from St. Mary's and a tiny bracelet.
Yes. I want to compare it with the COBRA page and the March budget before I send anything.
Keep it in the folder with my school papers. I can grab it Sunday when I come by.
Already did. Same drawer as the old UE parking pass and the Bloomington lease copy.
Bring the laptop too. I want to see the screens you made from those interview notes.
That drawer is basically my whole paper trail before and after that one school stretch.
I cleaned up two flows last night. They make more sense with the quotes beside the sketches.
Do you still need the old school portal login? I found the folder with your transcript request notes.
Yes, please keep it. One form wants the exact title from the diploma and the capstone line.
For Sunday, should I bring the small lasagna pan or the regular one?
Small is fine. It is just the two plates here, and she already planned soup for Monday.
I can bring the folder Sunday. It has the lab credits and that statistics project printout too.
That helps. I am matching those bits to two portfolio blurbs before I send the next batch.
Got it. Tell her I said thank you for keeping you both on the grocery list instead of takeout again.
She has the fridge mapped better than I do. I mostly follow instructions and chop onions.
I left the heating pad by your desk and moved the wrist brace out of the junk drawer.
Thanks. I was up at 3:20 again doing the portfolio/job math in my head, so today may be a coffee-and-stretches day.
Put the sleep notes in your phone before your Dr. Patel visit. Also write down what he said about options if the looping thoughts keep eating evenings.
Will do. I am not signing up for anything weekly or adding a daily pill just because this month is ugly.
I moved the Vectren date to the shared calendar. Don't pay it from checking yet.
Good catch. I was about to hit submit from the email.
Use my deposit for that one. Put your Friday amount toward groceries and gas.
Done. I'll send you the receipt once Kroger posts.
Do you still want Thai after groceries, or should I thaw the chicken?
Thaw the chicken. I moved the Chicago hotel hold out of March too.
Good. I'll update the sheet after dinner and leave the savings transfer alone until insurance clears.
Works. I also closed the parts cart I had open from yesterday.
I put the March premium draft and that dental estimate in the folder by the laptop.
Thanks. I moved the crown consult out of this month. Need to see what Friday's plan comparison does first.
Okay, but write down the new date so it doesn't disappear into portfolio week.
Already did. May 12 pencil mark, not confirmed.
Mom said you bailed from the family thread for an hour. You alive?
Yeah. Made noodles, did a lap around the block, then opened the sketch file from last weekend.
The one with the tiny neon storefront? Send it when it has windows.
After I clean the tablet layers. Trying not to overwork it tonight.
That printer still says offline. Your mom tried the blue button twice.
Leave it plugged in. I can look Saturday after I swap that porch bulb.
If you mount that strip under the shelf, leave room for the little box and a switch.
Bring the little screwdriver too. The hallway plate is loose.
Yeah, right now the breadboard is balanced on a TV tray. I need a bench that can stay messy for more than one night.
Got it. I'll text her when I'm heading over.
A folding table works until it doesn't. Put a rubber mat down if you're soldering.
Already burned a tiny mark in the old cutting board. The light sensor is reading clean now though.
I found the old folder with Meyer, Keller, and O'Neill papers. Some are from Dubuque and some from outside Bloomington.
Bring it Sunday if it is not a hassle. I can scan the useful pages and leave the rest boxed up.
Your grandmother would like that. She never wanted a big display, just names and dates kept straight.
That sounds about right. A clean PDF beats a fancy binder nobody opens.
Are you still planning to stop at the Civic Center before lunch? Take your license. They were checking it at the table last time.
Yes, going in person after I drop off that form for you. I want to read the school funding and riverfront notes again first.
The printer is doing that thing again where it says paper jam but there is no paper in it.
Good. Don't let the mailers decide for you. I saved the one from the teachers group if you want it.
Send me the model number from the back. I found a 6 minute walk-through and a comment thread with the exact blinking-light pattern.
Bring it Sunday. I already tossed the sheriff one with the scare headline.
HP 8025e. I took a picture too.
That's the one. Don't force the tray yet; the clip says the little gray lever snaps if you pull from the front.
Coffee is made. Did you ever heat up the soup or did you just keep clicking around?
I looked up and it was 1:40. The file is closer, but I kept changing the same two screens.
Before you reopen it, eat something with a fork. The slices in the fridge do not count as breakfast.
Fair. I'll make eggs, then send the link as-is instead of touching every label again.
Mom put the birthday pictures in the family album on FB. You probably missed them again.
I saw the notification but got pulled into that long Courier & Press piece first. I'll check the album at lunch.
Also don't touch Uncle Ray's comment chain. It already went sideways.
No plans to jump in. I just need the party time and whatever photos Mom added.
You still taking the car up north tomorrow?
Yeah, leaving before 7. I topped off the tires and checked oil tonight.
Good. Watch the tolls. What are you going there for this time?
Few Wabash stops, the river route if weather holds, and whatever small spaces are open late. Nothing here grabbed me this weekend.
Your dad asked if that arm thing is still worth doing this spring or if he can skip it.
I would not skip it. I sent him the CDC schedule page and the St. Vincent note that explains the timing.
Good. He reads better when it is one page and not a video.
I will print both Sunday and highlight the part that matches his age.
Did the 10-noon Figma block actually happen, or should I move dinner later?
It happened. I got the flow cleaned up and I owe Naomi a link before 2.
Good. Please add the insurance number to the bill sheet before you disappear into camera reviews.
Putting it in now, then lunch, then link. I am keeping the evening open for the movie.
Can you start bowls before I get home? Roasted broccoli is in the fridge.
Yep. Rice cooker at 5:50, eggs after that. I will reset the printer while the sauce sits.
Good. The kitchen drawer is catching again too.
I will tighten the runner after dinner. Should only need the small screwdriver.
If you come by later, bring that small socket set. The shelf bracket is loose again.
I can. I need to stop at Ace and Kroger first since they are both right by us.
Fine. Check your drip under the sink too. Did the office ever send maintenance?
Not yet. I put the note in yesterday. If they come before lunch, we may still take Lloyd out toward the trail lot this afternoon.
Forecast says the trail will be muddy by noon. Are you still doing your loop before groceries?
Maybe the short one. If I open Figma first, I know I will talk myself out of leaving.
Then shoes first, groceries after. I will start the list while you are gone.
Deal. If the drizzle turns sideways, I am calling it and coming back for coffee.
That portfolio review sounded rough. Want me to start rice or wait?
Start it in 20? I'm taking the river path first so I don't bring that call straight into dinner.
Okay. I put your light jacket on the chair. Wind picked up.
Thanks. Doing the longer loop, then I'll chop vegetables.
Found that little bracket you asked about. You still trying to hang something off the old tripod?
Yeah. I need the sensor to sit steady while the projector hits the foam board. If it shakes, the whole pattern looks sloppy.
Bring it by after lunch. We can drill two clean holes and use a washer instead of tape.
That would help. I want this version sturdy enough to show somebody outside the house.
Do you still want those appointment papers I saved from the clinic portal?
Yes. The library session asked for examples where a website was available but people still needed a counter and a phone number.
I can bring them Sunday. Please do not get pulled into arguing with strangers about it again.
I muted that whole post. I would rather hand them the papers and ask who staffs the desk after July.
For that example you showed me, the first page still starts too deep in the weeds.
Yeah, I cut the raw-column explanation down and moved the cleanup steps behind the chart.
Good. Lead with what changed, then let the details sit underneath.
I am swapping the tiny plots for one bigger view with a two-sentence note.
Dinner is cooling. Are you still in that saved-post rabbit hole?
Yeah. Found a small studio account doing exactly the kind of menu spacing I was stuck on.
Grab the useful part and close it. You were supposed to send two applications tonight.
Fair. I clipped three examples and put the phone in the kitchen.
Are you two still doing that tiny-theater thing after the wall-of-black-and-white-photos thing?
Yep. She wants the 6:20 one, and I want to get there early enough to see the prints before people crowd the room.
Of course you have a pre-plan for looking at frames on walls.
Laugh all you want. If dinner runs long, save me the meme and not a lecture.
Still thinking about that bridge choice. Dana was sure we should have paid the ferryman.
I had three versions written and you all picked the muddiest one.
That sounds like us. Are we aiming for the 20th or is Luis out?
20th works if everyone confirms. I need one night to redraw the mill floor before then.
I found the clipping you asked about. It was in the March 2020 folder with the city meeting notes.
Thanks. I'm trying to understand the timeline instead of just reacting to whatever gets shared around.
That sounds like you. Do you still want me to hold onto the older neighborhood map?
Yes, please. The map and the meeting notes say more together than either one alone.
Before dinner, can you tell me where the case study actually is? Not the polished version, just the real status.
Real status: wireframes done, write-up messy, screenshots not cleaned. I was avoiding saying that because I wanted it to sound closer.
Okay. Then after we eat, we look at the electric bill and pick what gets done by Friday.
Deal. I will keep it to two blocks tonight and not turn the office light back on at 11.
Did the 35mm win in Chicago or did you just argue with glass boxes all day?
35mm was perfect under the tracks. I got a decent shot of the Monadnock entrance too.
That beats the same three downtown corners here.
Exactly. I needed streets where turning a corner actually changes the whole mood.
I found your old choir folder and the basement class certificate in the storage tub. Keep both?
Keep the folder if it isn't mildewed. The certificate can go.
That sounds like you. You always cared more about the four-part songs than the certificate wall.
The singing stuck. The rest feels more like family history now.
Can you move the Kroger pickup? Your CVS slot is still on the shared calendar.
Moved groceries to 7:15. CVS should be quick unless they make me wait the full 15 after.
Take the article you saved too, because you know the pharmacist will ask which version you mean.
Already bookmarked the Johns Hopkins explainer and the link at the bottom to the paper.
Sending you this because it is exactly you when Dad asks where the PDF went.
Rude but accurate. I found it hiding in Downloads last weekend.
Coffee Friday? I can do 8:15 before I head back down 41.
Works. Same place by the library?
Are you making the Hoosier thing tonight or should I bring the lens to game night instead?
Trying to make it. I have been staring at the portfolio grid too long and need to move before I rewrite it again.
Clouds look rude, but not apocalyptic. I can drop the 35mm off after if you survive the river path.
If they start before I get there, I will just catch the back half.
Did you see the 35mm street shots I sent? That handle posts a lot of weird Midwest light.
Saved it this morning. Then the app decided I needed a hundred people with perfect studios.
Mute the perfect-studio parade and keep the lens stuff. Also, tabletop at 7 Friday?
Friday works. I already made a folder for the lens posts so I can stop wandering.
Do you still need that little tripod repaired or was that just for your Ohio river walk thing?
Still need it. It folds small enough for carry-on and the shrine steps on my saved map look uneven.
Bring it Sunday. Also check if those legs lock right before you trust it somewhere far.
Will do. Everything I've dragged it through so far has been Indiana, Kentucky, or Tennessee sidewalks, so it's due for a real test.
Can you look at my laptop Saturday? Also, did that place ever send the paper from last summer?
I can look after lunch. The paper showed up, just the short run from late winter into July.
Keep the dates plain. Folks reading it don't need a story.
That is what I am doing. One line for the role, one line for the dashboard work, then back to the prototype sample.
Man from your old office called the house by mistake. Said there is a reporting seat open again.
Thanks. I saw the email. It would be steady, but I am keeping this month for the portfolio and calls.
Steady matters. Just keep the numbers written down.
I am. Rent, insurance, groceries, and the application list are all on one sheet.
Can you still help me with the clinic portal at 3:30 today?
Yes. I have a 1-2:30 screen share, then I will come by with my laptop.
Thank you. Put it on your calendar so I do not have to chase you.
Already did. If the call runs over, I will text by 2:20, not at the last minute.
Did you want me to save that Dr. Fenwick postcard? It says reminder on it.
Yes, please. I'm not booking it until I know which card is active after the 15th.
I'll put it with the mail on the counter. Don't let the portal lock you out again.
I won't. I need the same login for the plan documents anyway.
Did you remember to send Dr. Patel the log from the last two weeks?
Yes. It shows the 2 a.m. wakeups pretty clearly, especially on application nights.
Good. Keep the list he gave you somewhere you can find it, even if you do not call anyone now.
It is in the folder. For now I am trying the schedule changes and desk setup first.
Did you two get that insurance form sent in? I can never remember if it needed the March statement too.
She scanned it last night and left me the envelope to drop at lunch.
Good. Tell her I said thank you for keeping the dates straight.
Will do. I also need to ask her which card we used for the premium.
Can you grab onions, coffee filters, and the picture hooks before you come back?
Yep. I can do Schnucks, the coffee place, and Lowe's without leaving this side.
Good. Also the renewal packet is still on the counter. We should read it before Sunday.
I'll look tonight. If Saturday stays dry, let's head out early and use 66 before the lots fill up.
I started the rice. Can you handle peppers when you get back?
Yep. Taking the long way home first, then I will chop.
Fine. Please keep the little amp off after 9. I have the library book due tomorrow.
No amp. Just nylon strings in the office for a few minutes.
Mom says you are bringing food Sunday. Please tell me it is not just another pot of noodles.
Vegetable ramen, but with the good broth. Also bringing the spare HDMI cable for Dad.
Coffee after Mom's on Sunday or are you hiding from civilization again?
Let's do coffee at the house. I already kicked Chicago and the sensor-kit cart into April.
Fine, fancy noodles count. Dad also mentioned the wobbly shelf by the printer.
I will toss the drill in the trunk with the container.
Your unfinished project shelf survives another month. I'll bring the movie meme.
Coffee Saturday? Mom said you disappeared after the game last week, so I am checking before you book your cave.
Coffee works if we keep it early. 10:00 at Penny Lane?
Deal. Bring the weird book with the sand worms if you finished it. I want to see why Marcus keeps defending it.
I'll bring it. I am keeping the afternoon empty so I can sit with that Kierkegaard chapter before dinner.
Mom asked if you're still coming Sunday. Also I found a meme about moving sticky notes instead of doing the thing.
Rude but accurate. I owe the portfolio draft tomorrow morning and somehow spent 40 minutes renaming sections.
Send one ugly version and then eat dinner. I know your 'just one more pass' face.
Ordering a small pizza now so I stop wandering between the kitchen and the laptop.
Mom says you still have the Lloyd pool pass with that terrible kid photo.
Unfortunately yes. It survived more moves across town than it deserved.
Across town plus your tiny Bloomington room. That barely counts as a move.
Fair. I only packed like three boxes and came back after finals.
Saw this meme and immediately thought of your dining table covered in wires again.
Rude but accurate. The distance sensor kept firing when the cat walked past, so dinner got relocated.
Please tell me the blinking thing is at least for the portfolio and not just to annoy your wife.
Portfolio first, annoyance second. I need one wall where I can leave it taped up overnight.
Can you look at the laptop fan this evening? Making that grinding sound again.
Yes. I need to do the Greenway miles after that recruiter email, then I'll come by with the small screwdriver kit.
Fine. Text when you leave the trailhead.
Saw they are putting QR signs on the river trail. Is that what you went to City Hall about?
Partly. Signs are fine, but the cracked section by the boat ramp still needs gravel and drainage before spring rains.
That sounds like a shovel problem, not a phone problem.
Exactly. I am sending the photo set to the parks staff, not feeding the comment fight under the council clip.
That file you sent opens, but I only see a bunch of rows. Which part matters?
Open the second sheet. I cleaned the duplicate entries and marked the three lines that explain the dip.
The colored one makes more sense than the rows.
Exactly. The picture is doing the work; the rows are just there if someone asks.
You going to that courthouse thing tomorrow or are we fixing the shelf first?
Shelf first. I don't think I'm making the township one. Half the names are signs I've only seen at stoplights.
Fair. I just don't want another guy promising to cut everything and then the roads get worse.
Same. If I go, I'm checking the library board and transit notes before I pick anything.
Before you send that sample page, make sure a person who has never seen your laptop can understand what changes on the wall and why.
Good point. I cut the paragraph down and added a before/after image from the bus stop numbers.
Also put the practical part first. Who it helps, where it would sit, what they would need from you.
I am making a little version for the neighborhood association meeting. One page, no jargon, photos included.
Can you mark going for the church fish fry? They put the time on the FB event but I can't find the address.
Found it: Friday 5:30, St. Mark's hall. I checked the parish page too because the event had two different times.
Thank you. Your dad said the comments under the road story are a mess.
I saw enough. I'm sticking with the county update and the paper's follow-up.
Aunt Karen asked if you can bring the old photo scan to the birthday thing. She said the one with the O'Neill cousins on the porch.
Sure. I will put it on a flash drive and not turn it into a slideshow production.
Thank you, because nobody needs Uncle Ray narrating 80 porch photos.
Exactly. One folder, labeled clearly, done.
We’re one short at the court around 2. Nothing serious, just half-court and bad knees.
I can do an hour. I still have those old high-tops somewhere.
Good. And don’t wear anything blue unless you want Nate making Indianapolis jokes.
He can talk after he hits a layup.
Still borrowing my 35mm after that lens demo tonight?
If you can bring it by 5:30. We are heading from the demo straight to the restored print at 8.
You and your wife have very specific Saturday routes.
Specific routes beat sitting around scrolling for two hours.
I finished those chapters you sent. The part about discretion changing block by block was the strongest section.
Yeah. It made me think about how my two traffic stops here were boring warnings, and other people plan their whole route around avoiding one.
That's a hard sentence, but it tracks. Same rulebook, different practical result.
Exactly. I'm trying to keep listening before I act like I understand the whole thing.
You still want that Minolta 50mm I sent you, or are you behaving this month?
Behaving. I cleaned the sticky aperture on the one I already have instead.
Responsible and annoying. Did the extra flash sell?
Pending pickup Monday. I kept the working one and let the duplicate go.
That drill you mentioned, does it come with two batteries or one?
Two in the bundle. I watched a torque test last night and then read three owner posts about the chuck wobble.
Chuck wobble is what ruins the cheap ones.
Exactly. The teardown guy liked the motor, but the comments were split on the trigger after a year.
Do you still have that folding table, or did your apartment finally eat it?
Still have it. The second room is packed with my desk, her books, and camera stuff, but the table folds behind the door.
Perfect. Also Mom asked if you two are hosting Easter dessert or just showing up with something.
Showing up. We are keeping home projects small until the job and savings picture is less wobbly.
Mom says you are the designated ride from dinner again because everybody trusts your boring water routine.
Boring is useful. I want to be home clear-headed enough to finish that portfolio section.
Fair. Also did your Monday appointment make you late?
No, quick in and out. They mostly said keep doing normal stuff and sent me the lab note.
You still coming by after lunch or buried in that computer thing?
Coming by at 1. I told her last night I blew past the 15th mark, so today's list is just the shelf, screenshots, and one application.
Bring the drill battery. And don't make the list bigger while you're here.
That's the rule now. Small list, say what slipped, then actually do it.
I moved the bills folder off the dining table. Your graph paper and little figures are still there.
Thanks. I only need the left half tonight so I can finish the cellar layout.
Is Marcus the one bringing snacks again or should I grab chips tomorrow?
Marcus said he'll bring something. I'll text the other two after dinner.
Mom wants a head count for Easter lunch after Grandma's program. Are you in?
Lunch yes. I'll do Bluegrass Trail early and meet you after.
Still picking trees over the dress-shoes hour, I see.
I can handle the songs. An hour in rows makes me count ceiling tiles.
Before Saturday, can you help me turn that campaign loot spreadsheet into something less cursed?
Send the CSV. I can write a quick Python pass to group by player and catch the weird blanks.
If you make a graph, label it like I am not in your head.
Fair. I will keep the code offscreen and make the chart title do the explaining.
Game Saturday still good, or are you doing the sore-arm ritual again?
Still good. I am doing the pharmacy thing Friday morning, so by Saturday I should only be mildly useless at dice.
Send me the plain-English source you mentioned. My uncle is passing around screenshots again.
I will send the STAT piece, but use the one with the actual paper linked, not the repost.
Saw a reel of a tiny kitchen with green tile and thought of your endless 'maybe someday' folder.
Do not mock the folder. It has range.
It also has your whole lunch break if you open it.
True. Send it anyway. I will save it after I finish this wireframe.
Movie Saturday still happening or did the grown-up envelope pile win again?
Meme for you: guy opens 47 tabs and calls it a plan.
Still happening. She made me put the Comcast login and the washer repair slip in the folder before dinner.
Accurate. Half are Figma frames and half are the budget sheet.
Did you at least make the coffee app thing less ugly?
Yes. Added the interview clips beside the new screens, then cut the subscription list again.
That tracks. Bring snacks and don't forget the receipt if she wants it for the March sheet.
I already sent her the total. My card is just taking the snack hit this time.
Are you bringing the glowing doorway thing Sunday or is it still in pieces?
In pieces, but less shamefully. The motion trigger finally stops double-counting people.
Good. Also your next place needs a corner where that stuff can live permanently.
That's the dream: pegboard, bins, a real work surface, and no packing it all into shoeboxes.
For Saturday, pizza at the shop before the campaign or table snacks at my place?
Snacks at yours if that's okay. I'm keeping receipts boring until the 1st.
Fine by me. Also, are you still bringing that lens adapter you were arguing about?
Nope, left it in the cart. I'll bring the old lens and the sci-fi book instead.
You joining the lens argument or did you disappear into tablet land again?
Your dice heat map thing is unfairly cool. The red cluster made my terrible rolls look like evidence.
Tablet for a bit. Blocking in the alley scene, then ten quiet minutes with the old Yamaha.
That is exactly the trick I want: numbers on the table becoming something people can read at a glance.
That sounds more disciplined than my plan, which is reading reviews until midnight.
Could a shop use that for foot traffic? Or is that too normal for your mad scientist board?
A shop, gallery night, donation table, anything with a simple count behind it. I need two cleaner examples before I ask around.
Discipline is generous. I just need my hands doing something that is not scrolling.
Found your great-granddad's tool chest tag. Keller Hardware, Evansville, 1958. Still has the little brass plate.
That is worth keeping. I can clean the plate and tighten the drawer slides Saturday.
No need to refinish the whole thing. It worked fine for him beat up.
Agreed. Make it usable, leave the honest scratches.
Need you to look at the laptop Sunday. Same house, back door still sticks.
I can come after lunch. I need to pick up that folder from Mom anyway.
Found your old Central library card in the garage. The one from before you left for that program.
Keep it with the rest. That program was short enough that half my stuff never left your place.
You still coming by Sunday to look at the printer?
Yes. I may bring the laptop too. The portal keeps showing two different totals for the April start.
Bring the paper copy. Easier to mark what they changed.
Good idea. I also need to decide whether to keep the glasses appointment on the 27th.
I found that spare keyboard tray in the garage. Want it Sunday?
Yes. My right wrist has been cranky after portfolio edits, and the neck thing comes back when the laptop is too low.
Bring the chair measurements. Also, your mom asked if the clinic gave you anything to pick up.
No pickup. Just the printout and the tracking sheet.
When you come by Sunday, could you bring your laptop? The insurance page keeps looping after the code.
Yes. Don't retry it too many times. I'll bring mine and we can do it at the kitchen table.
Thank you. I put the mail from them in the basket by the back door.
Good. I'll also tighten that cabinet handle Dad mentioned.
I found the birth certificate copy in the folder with your old Chicago hotel receipts.
Perfect, thank you. The form wanted that before I can do anything with the fare alert.
Do you need me to scan it, or are you stopping by after work?
I'll stop by. I also want to show you the temple walkway photo set I bookmarked so you know why I'm fussing over this.
Do you want me to tell Marcus dinner after camera walk is a no?
Yes please. Walk and lens arguing are good, but I do not have a second stop in me tonight.
Got it. I put your Stanislaw Lem book on the side table with the little blue one by Epictetus.
Thanks. That is exactly the kind of Friday I can handle.
Mom says you are making another giant chart thing. Please tell me it has fewer tiny boxes than the last one.
It has fewer boxes. It is for a research panel, a visualization studio, and one interactive media group.
Very you. Did you use the old campus project where you made everyone stare at sensors?
A cleaned-up version. I am only sending three this week, then stopping before I start over-polishing.
Still good for game prep at noon? I have two lens opinions ready to annoy you.
Make it 12:30. I'm at Angel Mounds getting a few trail miles in before I answer that rejection.
12:30 works. Save the email for after the dirt part.
That's the plan. I'll bring the sci-fi book too.
Game tonight at my place. Same table by the window, unless the patio crowd gets annoying again.
Window table is better. Last time my jacket smelled like the patio all night.
Copy. I picked up seltzer and the short cans you never finish.
Perfect. I also have no pill-timer beeps to work around, so I can stay through the final encounter.
I tagged you in the game swap event. Don't vanish from the site before you hit RSVP.
Done. That plus the camera buy-sell group is about all I opened it for tonight.
There's a spicy thread under the school board clip if you're bored.
Hard pass. Send me the meeting link or a decent write-up if there's actual substance.
If you pass Wesselman before your mom's thing, can you bring the Allen key set?
Yeah. I'm doing the loop first, then I can tighten the brackets in the basement hall.
Choir starts at 10 according to your mother. Brackets after that is fine.
Works. Quiet walk, songs, brackets. That's about my speed.
Before groceries, can you check whether the PayPal transfer cleared?
It did. The strap and the 35mm finder both paid out overnight.
Good. Keep the little screws off the dining table before my book club sees them.
Already swept them into the tray. The Konica can sit lens-down until I cut new foam.
Do we need anything besides chicken thighs and ginger?
Grab cornstarch too. The cook in the 12 minute clip used it after marinating, and the thread below had people saying it keeps the sauce from sliding off.
Fine, but no surprise specialty bottle this time.
Fair. I already checked the pantry against the comments before adding anything.
I paid CenterPoint and moved the insurance draft to the 28th.

events.title: Greenway loop before portfolio edits
events.notes: Shoes by door; start near Heidelbach. Review application notes after shower.

events.title: Save morning references
events.notes: Keep to 15 min. Chair joinery, poster layouts, window-light portraits. No checking profile stats before portfolio work.

events.title: Case study edits
events.notes: Tighten 2 screens, export before 11:10, send draft to Naomi by 11:15. Groceries after.

events.title: Dinner prep + hallway outlet
events.notes: Arborio, mushrooms, stock. Check loose plate by hallway outlet before movie.

events.title: Office drop-off + quick east-side loop
events.notes: Envelope at front office before close. Then Schnucks, Ace, and coffee beans. Keep the I-69 ramp side open for Saturday morning.

events.title: Hoosier Runners at Pigeon Creek
events.notes: Go if the case-study edits are wrapped by 5:30 and the rain holds off.

events.title: CO2 sheet -> wall dots test
events.notes: Cheap sensor, p5 sketch, short-throw projector. Save photos for one-page sample. List 3 possible places: bakery window, clinic lobby, Haynie's Corner table.

events.title: Portfolio prototype export
events.notes: Pick one flow, export screens, and send the link before bed. If still at desk after 10:30, eat the soup first.

events.title: CVS minute slot
events.notes: Bring insurance card and old shot card. Recheck Dr. Nair portal note against CDC adult schedule page before going.

events.title: Portfolio pass: Riverbend export
events.notes: Use scrubbed CSV. Rerun Python notebook, keep only before/after table, then rewrite chart captions for someone seeing the numbers cold.

events.title: Bokeh talk, then 7:40 showing
events.notes: Park on Adams. Bring small notebook; tickets already in wallet app.

events.title: Library board listening session
events.location: Central Library, 200 SE Martin Luther King Jr Blvd, Evansville
events.notes: Ask about the bus stop bench near Bayard Park, Saturday form-help desk, and whether the kiosk pilot has a real person assigned after launch. Bring utility-bill examples, not screenshots from the thread.

events.title: Haynie's Corner gathering
events.notes: Bring water. Stand near the edge if it gets crowded. Read the city packet before we go.

events.title: Kitchen table: bills + March targets
events.notes: Bring laptop, checking account, insurance notice, grocery total, and case-study list. Pick three items for this week instead of the whole board.

events.title: Civic Center stop before portfolio work block
events.notes: Bring ID. Check notes on school board, road funding, clerk race. Skip if line is past the lobby.

events.title: Tabletop at Marcus's
events.notes: Bring dice, character notes, Le Guin for Marcus. Keep 9:30-10:30 clear for porch reading.

events.title: Dr. Patel follow-up
events.notes: Bring 2-week sleep log, keyboard/desk notes, and questions about the list he mentioned. No recurring appointment booked.

events.title: Compare Marketplace vs COBRA numbers
events.notes: Bring March premium notice, dental estimate, eye exam quote, and deductible sheet. Check provider list before choosing.

events.title: Portfolio pass: chart case + interaction demo
events.notes: Revise Methods section; add senior lab visual from archived coursework; mark March money sheet with incoming: $0 so far; check whether Feb-Jul project dates read cleanly.

events.title: Friday dice night - Marcus / Dana / Luis
events.notes: Print stat blocks, finish river crossing sketch, set out four pencils and spare d20s.

events.title: Friday receipts + March spreadsheet
events.notes: Add water bill confirmation, car insurance draft date, grocery total. Check which account rent should pull from before Monday.

events.title: Chicago day - Riverwalk, Wabash, gallery stops
events.notes: Leave early. Park near Millennium. Bring camera, sketchbook, charger. Check if anything better than the Evansville Friday listings.

events.title: Angel Mounds loop + creek bench
events.location: Angel Mounds State Historic Site, Evansville
events.notes: Thermos, phone off, old choral playlist for the last stretch. Meet Mom after if she still needs boxes moved.

events.title: Greenway loop + thumbnail sketches
events.notes: Bring small notebook. 4-count in / 6-count out before heading back.

events.title: Portfolio block + runway sheet
events.notes: Revise grocery checkout case study: before/after screens, 3 user quotes, final storyboard. Update savings tabs and April insurance line before dinner.

events.title: Passport photo and form check
events.notes: Bring birth certificate copy, old booklet if found, and camera bag dimensions. Recheck ORD-KIX fare alert after.

events.title: BMV renewal paperwork
events.location: Evansville West BMV, 2421 Allens Ln, Evansville, IN
events.notes: Bring current utility bill, old IN license, and folder with 09/14/1992 record copy. Check address line before submitting.

events.title: East side stop: printer, porch bulb, portal login
events.notes: Bring small screwdriver, spare bulb, charger cable. Coffee at Penny Lane after if she is free.

events.title: Check neighborhood page: water main update + library RSVP
events.notes: Compare city notice with Courier & Press before sharing anything to family thread.

events.title: New Harmony loop
events.notes: Pack sandwiches and coffee. Gas only. No overnight. Leave electronics cart parked.

events.title: Porch pickup + test roll notes
events.notes: Meet buyer for 49mm hood and cable release. Afterward check light leak notes from the Yashica roll.

events.title: Dad's place - TV on, bring shoes
events.notes: Check shelf brackets after. If Marcus texts back, stop by the gym for a short run.

events.title: Open house - check back room + detached bay
events.notes: Measure wall with outlets. Look for ceiling height, ventilation, and whether a folding table could stay out. Take photos of concrete-floor area.

events.title: Scan family papers for Mom
events.notes: Meyer farm receipt, O'Neill baptism copy, Dubuque cemetery photo, Bloomington clipping. Keep filenames plain and send ZIP, no layout work.

events.title: Budget check + March bills
events.notes: Review insurance, savings cushion, lease renewal, and whether the second room stays as desk/photo space through summer.

events.title: Annual check-in, fasting labs
events.notes: Bring insurance card. Update portal list: vitamin, allergy tablets as needed, no daily refills. Coffee after, not before.

events.title: Compare tripod heads + skillet sauce notes

events.title: Sign counter packet
events.notes: Scan pages, initial both spots, then leave copy at office. Stop for coffee after; check dinner options downtown if traffic on Lloyd is light.

events.title: Broth, mushrooms, rice prep

events.title: Mock review + application pass
